_comment: Enacted amending Laws and published figures that the income-tax rows rely on, recorded 2026-10-07. The Hebrew consolidation in ../ is Wikisource's unofficial text; where it and these differ, these are the enacted text. A statute is deposited as the PDF; a government publication that is not a statute is recorded by link and hash only (the convention in each SOURCE-LICENSE.md: such publications are carried as short quotations, not deposited). Both were fetched by the capstone's encoder (row legalese-2026-10-il-07) from Internet Archive captures; the lead re-checked both sha256 values against the bytes at deposit. Four Knesset PDFs (SH 2972, 3048, 3184, 3342) were added 2026-10-08 for BACKLOG IL-31 (fetch-il).

files.title: Economic Efficiency Law (Legislative Amendments for Achieving the Budget Targets for Budget Year 2026), 5786-2026 (Sefer HaChukim 3511, 31 March 2026)
files.retrieved_via: Internet Archive capture of the Knesset's own PDF
files.bears_on: ITO s 121: chapter C, ss 5 to 7 (PDF p. 4, Sefer HaChukim p. 416; corrected 2026-10-08 from p. 415, which is the end of chapter B, as the page image's folio and the capstone's second independent pass, O4, show) enact the individual's tax brackets from 1 January 2026, which confirm row il-03's 2026 brackets and the capstone's. Chapter D, s 9 (PDF pp. 4-6, Sefer HaChukim pp. 416-418) enacts the Encouragement of Aliyah and Return (Temporary Provision) Law 5786-2026, which no row encodes (BACKLOG IL-36); the capstone declines the earners it may reach (row legalese-2026-10-il-07, v0.3.0)
